observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly with multiple components; appears to be a complete engine or major engine assembly laid out/installed in a bay.
No clearly readable brand/model/engine code plate is visible in the photo.

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller statement is generic; photo 0 shows an engine assembly but does not confirm the specific spare part being sold or its exact identity.

risks.risk: Exact engine model/engine code is not readable, so the item could be a different engine than the comparables (wrong displacement/series).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine code/label (e.g., stamped code on block) and/or the ID plate showing model/engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case match among the provided comparables (i.e., treat as the cheapest comparable only if it truly matches; otherwise keep at the lowest end until identity is proven).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be incomplete, damaged, or not tested).
risks.proof: A short video showing the engine start/test (or compression test / leak-down test results) and a photo of all accessories included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / incomplete until proven.

risks.risk: Completeness of the 'complete engine' claim is unknown (missing turbo, wiring harness, ECU, intake/exhaust manifolds, etc.).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show ECU, starter, alternator, turbo (if applicable), intake manifold, exhaust manifold, wiring harness, and all hoses/bolts included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only until all key components are shown.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk (even if it’s the same engine family, year/variant differences matter).
risks.proof: Photo of the engine casting numbers + the donor vehicle details (year/model) or a VIN-based compatibility note.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable because compatibility cannot be confirmed remotely.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate on the engine block (readable).
Video or photos showing the engine is complete (turbo/ECU/wiring harness/manifolds/starter/alternator) and not missing major parts.
Proof of working status: start video or test report (compression/leak-down) and any warranty/return terms.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the exact engine identity (brand/model/engine code) and working/completeness status are not readable or verifiable from the single image, so a safe price cannot be matched to the comparables.
